mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed twenty-four-hour raw variance ratio for overlapping one-hour versus five-minute BTC returns crossing above unity identifies positive serial dependence replacing random-walk-or-reverting noise; follow the completed four-hour displacement for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed trailing four-hour close-to-close return at an upward unity crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: HVVRT compares the population variance of overlapping twelve-step return sums with twelve times the population variance of one-step returns. It measures serial dependence directly rather than volatility level, one-minute/five-minute sampling noise, Hurst fitting, price/average cross, range geometry, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcomes, reused events, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the same completed twenty-four-hour one-step realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, isolating trend onset inside July-like volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour serial-dependence unity-onset clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bars: exact aggregation of coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows into five-minute closes
features.one_step_returns: 288 consecutive five-minute close-to-close log returns ending at T, requiring 289 completed closes
features.q_step_returns: all 277 overlapping sums of twelve consecutive one-step returns
features.variance_ratio: population variance(q_step_returns)/(12*population variance(one_step_returns)), finite positive denominator
features.event: current VR strictly above 1 after immediately prior finite VR at or below 1
features.direction: strict completed trailing four-hour close-to-close return
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 288 one-step returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid four-hour decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after all source closes
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed raw q=12 variance-ratio unity onset under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no sampling, sample length, q, variance convention, unity event, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Lo-MacKinlay variance-ratio random-walk diagnostic, raw variance-ratio convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 288 completed five-minute close-to-close log returns; q=12; VR=population variance of all overlapping q-step sums divided by q times population variance of one-step returns; unity separates random-walk variance scaling from positive serial dependence
external_basis.selection_use: published variance-scaling identity, one-hour q=12 aggregation, unity benchmark, and trend interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes; no hypothesis-test statistic is claimed
